name: @kitr/kit-docs
description: kitr new --kit docs: A static docs site from markdown: sidebar, search, package-manager commands, dark mode and llms.txt.

kitr.name: docs
kitr.title: Docs kit
kitr.summary: Start a docs site from markdown files: a sidebar, search, dark mode and copies for coding agents, prerendered to static HTML.

kit.audience: Projects that need a docs site written in markdown, fast to load and easy for coding agents to read.

highlights.title: Write markdown, get pages
highlights.text: Each file in `content/docs/` is a page, ordered by `nav.json`.

highlights.title: Search and dark mode
highlights.text: Cmd+K searches every page, and the theme follows the system or the toggle.

highlights.title: Static and fast
highlights.text: Every page is prerendered to HTML, with no server to run.

highlights.title: Agents can read it
highlights.text: The build writes `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt` and a `.md` copy of every page.

run: The docs site, reloading as you edit markdown
Vitest, rendering a page with its sidebar
